summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, Conan, and some of Kogoro's friends are at a Mahjong hall. One of his friends leave so now they're missing a player. They call Hida who says he'll be there in half an hour. He doesn't show so the gang goes to investigate. They run into Minamizawa who says he forgot his cell phone. They go to check on Hida who's dead. Location: Hida Financial Office Victim: Mitsuhiro Hida Cause of death: Potassium cyanide poisoning Suspects: Hisayoshi Minamizawa, Takako Fujii, and Hiroshi Iino He suffocated because of potassium cyanide poisoning. The doors and the window of the room were locked.
